PLAN: Post-cook DDC benchmark to quantify current vs optimized DDC performance
PREREQUISITE: Current cook must complete naturally. Do NOT purge existing DDC until evidence preserved.

A_CURRENT_DDC.description: Re-run cook with identical flags against current DDC (warm)
A_CURRENT_DDC.expected: High DDC hit rate, but slow read throughput (0.00-0.08 MB/s)

B_WARM_RERUN.description: Immediate second cook run (fully warm DDC + cooked packages)
B_WARM_RERUN.expected: Maximum DDC hit rate, minimal shader compiles, wall clock dominated by package I/O

C_ALTERNATE_FAST_LOCAL_DDC.description: Configure alternate DDC on fast local NVMe (if available)
C_ALTERNATE_FAST_LOCAL_DDC.ddc_path: TARGET: Fast NVMe drive (e.g., C: or dedicated D:)
setup: +Root=(Type=FileSystem, ReadOnly=false, Clean=false, Flush=false, DeleteUnused=false, UnusedFileAge=30, MaxSizeMB=51200, Path="<FAST_NVME_PATH>\DDC", EnvPathOverride="UE4_DDC")
C_ALTERNATE_FAST_LOCAL_DDC.expected: Read throughput >500 MB/s on NVMe, DDC latency <0.5ms

MEASUREMENT_METHOD.shader_compile_count: Count 'LogShaderCompilers: Display: Worker' lines in log
MEASUREMENT_METHOD.texture_derivation_count: Count 'LogTexture: Display: Building texture' or DDC texture keys
MEASUREMENT_METHOD.ddc_hit_miss: Enable 'LogDerivedDataCache: Verbose' or parse 'Speed test' and access logs
MEASUREMENT_METHOD.wall_clock: LogCook: Display: Cook total time or process lifetime
MEASUREMENT_METHOD.ddc_read_throughput: Sample via Windows Performance Monitor (PhysicalDisk\Disk Read Bytes/sec) on DDC drive during cook
